items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Approve no new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; the aggregate amount is not site-attributable, so site revenue claims are unsupported. AI usage reports $886.12 across 4,865 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing/experiment costs are incomplete, monthly budget limits are blank, and no learning-outcome threshold is defined. Continue only existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation using recorded telemetry. Minimum measurement: attributable revenue by site, content, and tracking ID; reconciled AI-cost ledger; infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, approved-budget, and experiment-cost records; defined learning outcome and cost-to-learn threshold.

CFO handoff: retain repair-or-close, deterministic validation, rollback, deduplication, measurement reconciliation, and bounded legal/security evidence work already in progress. Defer all new proposals, queue work, experiments, telemetry, deployments, spending, commitments, and monetization changes. Do not treat impressions, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, orders, shipped items, or AI usage as financial return or causal lift.
